title: eleocharis palustris subsp. mamillata
intro: Eleocharis palustris subsp. mamillata, commonly known as the "Hairy Spike-rush", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which help to soothe wounds and promote tissue repair. The therapeutic actions of Eleocharis palustris subsp. mamillata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds and essential oils. However, the specific bioactive constituents of this plant have not been extensively studied, and further research is needed to confirm its exact composition and effects.
